summary: SF_STAIR_RISER_NC_v1 passes QA with 3 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 7 pipeline files present. Cross-file threading validated: 30 TSK_ IDs in sop_modules match 30 rates in production. All acceptance criteria from brief met. Canonical painting sequence (stringers before risers) enforced. Dual UOM (EA/LF) consistent across files. Tread protection mandatory and correctly modeled.

rule_1_tsk_sop_to_production.details: All 30 TSK_STRS_* task IDs in sop_modules.json have matching entries in production.json.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.details: ITM_STAIR_RISER and ITM_STAIR_STRINGER both appear in spec.json variants.

rule_3_sys_qt_match.details: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC→QT3, SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE→QT4, SYS_FF_PREMIUM→QT5 match spec.json configuration_dimensions.

rule_4_inputs_consumed.details: All IN_ inputs in spec.json are consumed by sop_modules or production tasks.

rule_5_ps_keys_match.details: All PS_ keys referenced in production/sop match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs.

rule_6_zones_match.details: 3 zone_ids (stair_tread_covers, floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent) match between spec.json and sop_modules protection_metadata.

rule_7_phase_order.details: Module sequence: setup → prep → prime → finish → interstage → finish → cleanup. Correct.

rule_8_uom_match.details: UOM consistent: riser tasks=EA, stringer tasks=LF, fixed tasks=FIXED in both sop_modules and production.

rule_9_tsk_prefix.details: All tasks use TSK_STRS_ prefix per resolution.json.

rule_10_itm_ids.details: Both ITM_ IDs are proposed (new), correctly marked in resolution and spec.

rule_11_enum_values.details: All enum values used across files match resolution.json applicable_enums.

acceptance_criteria_check.criterion: Combined prime+paint with primer conditional on substrate_state
EA counting for risers, LF counting for stringers
Railing system excluded — routed to SF_STAIR_RAILING_NC
Stairwell walls/ceilings excluded — routed to drywall specs
MDF edge sealing task for bare MDF
Tread protection mandatory from setup to cleanup
Fine Finish combined prime+paint module structure
Risers H1, stringers use stairwell access modifiers
State declarations: input SS_BARE/SS_PRIMED_FACTORY, output SS_PAINTED

issues.description: Riser production rates are research estimates (A-002 from research.json). No canonical doctrine provides per-EA riser painting rates. Estimates derived from trim LF rates and riser SF calculation.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field validation. Rates are reasonable estimates based on trim doctrine. Refine after field testing.

issues.description: Open stringer multiplier (1.4x) is the midpoint of the 1.3-1.5x range specified in brief. No canonical doctrine value exists (A-005 from research.json).
issues.suggested_fix: Acceptable for initial spec. Refine based on field data comparing open vs closed stringer painting times.

issues.description: Default QT3 + default semi-gloss creates tension — sheen/QT gate requires QT4+ for semi-gloss. Runtime enforcement will reject semi-gloss at QT3 and offer satin as alternative (U-001 from research.json).
issues.suggested_fix: Acknowledged tension — same as trim spec. Runtime gate handles this correctly. Consider documenting effective default: QT3+satin or QT4+semi-gloss.

doctrine_compliance.stairway_systems_doctrine: Compliant. Canonical sequence enforced (stringers #4, risers #8). QT2 prohibited. Tread protection mandatory. Substrate-specific primer selection.
doctrine_compliance.fine_finish_doctrine: Compliant. Combined prime+paint. Interstage at all QTs. Sanding discipline per tier. QT5 brush/roll 3+ coats.
doctrine_compliance.millwork_nc_paint_doctrine: Compliant. MDF two-step prime. Poplar stain-blocking mandatory. Hardwood tannin-blocking.
doctrine_compliance.paintscope_stairwell_geometry_system: Compliant. Riser count from PS_META.STAIRWELL.RISERS. Stringer LF from rake_length. Access modifiers from max_working_height. Access modifiers do NOT stack with height modifiers for component work.
doctrine_compliance.modifier_registry: Compliant. H1 for risers, stairwell access modifiers for stringers. QT modifiers on qt_scaled tasks. No prohibited modifier values.
doctrine_compliance.conventions: Compliant. CON_ prefix (not CONS_). task_classification (not task_class). Severity values correct. Phase values correct. All units uppercase.

key_innovations: First spec with dual UOM (EA + LF) for two different paintable items in same spec
First spec with stairwell access modifiers (separate from standard height modifiers)
First spec requiring mandatory safety protection (tread covers) as non-negotiable binary task
First spec with substrate-conditional MDF two-step prime process
First spec with 5 distinct substrate-driven primer paths
